title: Connect your radio to Wi-Fi
label: Illustrated guide
description: A silent illustrated guide to Wi-Fi setup using the radio's touchscreen. All instructions are captioned.
steps: On the radio, tap Settings on the home screen.
Tap Wi-Fi. Wait for your network to appear.
Choose your network. Scan refreshes the list; Type name lets you enter it.
Type your Wi-Fi password on the radio, then tap Connect.
Wait for the home screen. If setup fails, check the password and try again.
sources: Firmware: waveshare_radio/touch_ui.h — uiDrawWifi, uiDrawKeyboard, uiTap and serviceTouchUi

title: Add a station from the website
label: Illustrated guide
description: A silent illustrated guide to tapping a station to add it automatically, with Device Code linking for a new phone. Example numbers are not real device credentials.
steps: Keep your radio on and connected to Wi-Fi. Open Radio and tap a station.
If your phone is not linked, enter the Device Code and tap Add station.
For a new phone, match the confirmation numbers on the phone and radio.
Tap Allow on the physical radio. Deny requests you did not start.
The station is added automatically. No extra confirmation is needed.
Wait for Station added, then tap Done. Linked phones skip the linking steps.
sources: Website: public/index.html — Radio and shared station form
Website: public/assets/directory-news.js — station tile and openStationPopup

title: Reset the Device Code
label: Illustrated guide
description: A silent illustrated guide to resetting the Device Code on the physical radio. Resetting unlinks every phone.
steps: Resetting the Device Code unlinks every phone. Start on the physical radio.
On the radio's home screen, tap the large Device Code.
Tap Reset code to change the code and disconnect all linked phones.
Keep Wi-Fi connected. Wait for the new code; a reset lock lasts 60 seconds.
Use the new Device Code to reconnect. Match the number and tap Allow on the radio.
sources: Firmware: waveshare_radio/touch_ui.h — home Device Code tap target
Firmware: waveshare_radio/radio_link.h — requestRadioCodeReset, completeRadioCodeReset and drawRadioLinkPage
